hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.jsx|*.tsx|*.js|*.ts) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/terminal" 2>/dev/null && npx vite build --logLevel error 2>&1 | tail -3 ;; *.py) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null && python -m py_compile "$f" 2>&1 ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
echo '{"systemMessage": "Remember: run tests before claiming done. Check CLAUDE.md SOP."}'

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *'rm -rf /'*|*'rm -rf ~'*|*'format'*|*'DROP TABLE'*|*'--force'*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command blocked by hook"}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
